Cleaning Services Built for Schools & Early Childhood Facilities

From daily custodial rounds to semester-break deep cleans and childcare-specific sanitation protocols, every service is built around the demands of educational environments — where surface contamination spreads fast, documentation is required, and your facility director needs consistency, not just a clean building.

settings.altText: Commercial custodial and janitorial cleaning service in a K-12 school hallway — Minneapolis–St. Paul metro

settings.text: Custodial & Janitorial Services

Daily and weekly custodial service covering classrooms, hallways, restrooms, cafeterias, gymnasiums, locker rooms, and administrative offices. A documented service log is left on-site after every visit — giving your facility director a verifiable record for each service performed. Crews are trained on educational facility protocols and consistently assigned to your building.
Floor Care & Maintenance Solutions

Hard floors, gymnasium floors, and carpeted hallways each require different maintenance protocols. We strip, seal, and restore hard surfaces, and perform extraction cleaning on carpets — keeping corridors and amenity floors presentable year-round.

settings.altText: Professional gymnasium floor cleaning and maintenance service for a K-12 school in the Twin Cities metro
Commercial floor care and maintenance for schools in Minneapolis

settings.text: Deep Cleaning & Sanitization

Periodic deep cleaning for classrooms, common areas, and specialty spaces between semesters, during breaks, or ahead of facility inspections. We cover ceilings, vents, baseboards, and all surfaces not reached in routine service.

settings.altText: EPA-registered disinfection service applied in a K-12 school classroom — Precision Commercial Cleaning, Twin Cities

settings.text: Disinfection Services

EPA-registered disinfectants applied with electrostatic sprayers deliver full surface coverage across classrooms, restrooms, cafeterias, gymnasiums, and shared common areas. Formulations are selected for effectiveness against influenza, norovirus, RSV, and common cold viruses — safe for occupied or recently vacated spaces, with no harsh residues or disruptive odors. For early childhood facilities, dwell times are strictly observed before children re-enter any treated space.

settings.altText: Licensed early childhood center and daycare facility professionally cleaned by Precision Commercial Cleaning — Minneapolis–St. Paul

settings.text: Early Childhood & Childcare Facility Cleaning

Licensed preschools, daycare centers, and early childhood programs operate under stricter sanitation requirements than K–12 schools. Our service scope for these facilities includes toy sanitization, crib and rest area disinfection, low-surface cleaning on play equipment, diaper-changing station treatment, and product selections that meet Minnesota childcare licensing chemical safety standards. Every product used carries a published safety data sheet available on request.

settings.altText: Green cleaning and low-chemical protocol service for schools and early childhood facilities — Precision Commercial Cleaning, Twin Cities

settings.text: Green Cleaning & Low-Chemical Protocol

For facilities serving children under five, we default to EPA-registered, low-VOC, fragrance-free formulations that eliminate harsh chemical residues and airborne irritants. Green cleaning protocols are available across all service types — daily custodial, floor care, disinfection, and deep cleaning — and can be documented in your service agreement for licensing compliance or district policy requirements.

A dedicated, background-checked crew stays matched to your account. Quality Audits

Regular inspections — both scheduled and unannounced — maintain consistent quality across your facility. Any issue is resolved within one business day and recorded in your service file. For schools subject to district or licensing reviews, these records are available on request.

School & Education Cleaning FAQs — Twin Cities

Precision Commercial Cleaning serves K–12 schools, early childhood centers, and educational facilities across Minneapolis–St. Paul.

Here are the questions we hear most from facility directors, principals, and school administrators.
How often should a school be professionally cleaned?

Most K–12 schools require daily cleaning of classrooms, restrooms, hallways, and cafeterias during the academic year. Gymnasiums and high-traffic common areas typically need daily attention. Deep cleaning — covering vents, behind furniture, locker interiors, and surfaces not reached in daily service — is scheduled during breaks and semester transitions. We build the schedule around your calendar so service never disrupts the school day.

For licensed daycare and preschool facilities, daily service typically includes toy sanitization, crib and rest area disinfection, and low-surface cleaning in addition to the standard scope — with product selections that meet Minnesota childcare licensing standards for chemical safety.
Do you use EPA-approved disinfectants in school environments?

Every disinfectant we use in school environments is EPA-registered and selected for effectiveness against the pathogens most common in schools — influenza, norovirus, RSV, and common cold viruses. We do not use products with harsh chemical residues or strong odors that affect air quality in occupied spaces. Safety data sheets are available for every product on request.

For early childhood centers, service scope also includes outdoor play equipment surfaces, sensory room materials, nap and rest areas, and diaper-changing stations — areas subject to heightened sanitation requirements under Minnesota childcare licensing rules.
Are your cleaning products safe for young children and infants?

Yes. For early childhood centers, daycare facilities, and preschools, we select EPA-registered, low-VOC formulations that are fragrance-free and free of harsh chemical residues. All products have published safety data sheets available on request. Dwell times are observed strictly so surfaces are fully dry and safe before children re-enter any cleaned space. We do not use products with strong odors or airborne irritants in facilities serving children under five.
Can you clean during school hours or do you only service after-hours?

Most school cleaning is performed after-hours — after dismissal, after athletic events, or during scheduled building closures — to avoid disrupting instruction or student access. However, we do provide daytime restroom maintenance, cafeteria turnaround between lunch periods, and spot-cleaning services for facilities with custodial gaps during the school day. All scheduling is coordinated with your facilities director, principal, or operations manager before service begins.
How do I get a cleaning quote for my school or educational facility?

Submit a quote request through our website and we will respond within 48 hours. For schools, we schedule a brief walkthrough before finalizing the proposal — scope varies significantly based on square footage, grade level, number of restrooms, and athletic facilities. Every proposal is itemized and specific to your building. There are no generic packages, and quotes carry no obligation.

For early childhood centers and licensed daycare facilities, the walkthrough also covers the number of licensed care spaces, toy and equipment inventory requiring regular sanitization, nap area configuration, and any product restrictions required by your licensing agreement.
